top_choice_rationale: P001 is the one achievement whose mechanism is determined at the level I require: ternary complexes of E3 ligase, small molecule and target are resolved structurally, cooperativity and degradation kinetics are quantified, and cereblon explains in molecular terms why thalidomide-class drugs work. Induced proximity is a general, widely reproduced principle, and Crews, Deshaies and Handa anchor its two halves, provided the citation names the principle and not the clinical pipeline and the expert reports confirm the priority judgment relative to Ciulli, Sakamoto and Kim. P002 is mature, cleanly attributed and valuable but closer to refinement after the 2010 cross-coupling prize; no award ranks last because a ripe, well-supported candidate exists.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; Xiaodong Zou is a Stockholm University colleague but is not a candidate in any proposal
